title: AGTTM Part 7 - Traffic Controllers
abstract: AGTTM Part 7 establishes the definitive framework for Traffic Controllers performing stop-slow baton duties within temporary traffic management environments. The document specifies competency requirements, operational procedures, and positioning protocols essential for safe traffic control operations. It details signaling techniques, communication protocols, and hazard awareness practices that ensure controller safety and effective traffic flow management. The standard addresses emergency procedures and outlines comprehensive training and accreditation requirements for personnel.

keyRequirements.requirement: Traffic Controllers must hold current accredited competency certification
Controllers must maintain clear visibility and appropriate positioning
Standardized stop-slow baton signaling techniques must be applied consistently
Personal protective equipment including high-visibility clothing must be worn at all times

complianceNotes.note: Traffic Controller accreditation must be obtained from a registered training organization
complianceNotes.consequence: Non-compliant controllers cannot legally perform traffic control duties
